lines.t: Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
Yeah, the voice of the living one calls
From lightning, from cloud, from fire
He writes his law upon our hearts
His truth our souls desire
No idols raised, no name profane
Only his glory we proclaim
Proclaim, proclaim, proclaim
I will walk in his word, I will stand in his light
Obey his commandments, both day and night
The Lord is my shepherd, my rock, my king
All glory to God, I'll forever sing
Honor your father, your mother in peace
Love your neighbor, let anger cease
No coveted heart, no false report
In mercy and truth, I'll make my court
I will walk in his word, I will stand in his light
Obey his command, both day and night
The Lord is my shepherd, my rock, my king
All glory to God, I forever sing
His spirit whispers, choose the way
The narrow pathway, love holds sway
His hand upholds me when I fall
His covenant life fulfills it all
I will walk in his world
I will stand in his light
Obey his command
Both day and night
Forever his servant
His truth I bring
All glory to God
I'll forever sing
